desc:
A competitive duel fighting game, sequel to RAMPANT

🎮 Available on ALL devices!
⚙️ Keybinds & touch controls are customizable via settings in the top right corner
💎 2x Gems and XP on weekends!

> The game is very competitive. Every class is good if you know how to use it.
> Yes, this is made by the same creator of RAMPANT
> Thanks for playing, don't forget to leave a like! - Jack :)
